title: digitaria phaeotricha
intro: Digitaria phaeotricha, commonly known as finger millet, is a type of small-grained cereal crop belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Digitaria phaeotricha include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower cholesterol levels, while its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
